messages:
maria-partnerships: Quick sync — final-mile for marketplace launch. We need press embargo windows, blog + landing copy, SI partner asset handoff, and legal signoff by EOD Friday. Who can take each lane?
aj-marketing: I can own press + blog draft. Will pair with design for hero assets. Need embargo window from partnerships. :memo:
kevin-product: Landing page checklist is ready. I dropped the proto in /docs/landing-v1 and a small QA matrix. Will need a final hero SVG and one CTA variant.
sienna-legal: I can do legal review but need the exact press language + any partner quotes. Send me the draft, and I’ll prioritize. Typical turnaround 24–36h.
oliver-eng: From infra side, any required changes to marketplace listing schema? If partners are sending manifests we should validate now.
lena-sis: SI kit readiness: we have the onboarding runbook at 80%. Need sample tenant + customer success checklist from product. ETA Thu noon.
devon-ops: Any infra cutover windows? Prefer midnight PT for staging -> prod push but can shift if legal/press needs embargo.
aj-marketing: Embargo proposal: press embargo at 10:00am PT Wed next week. That gives us 4 working days to lock copy + assets. Agree?
maria-partnerships: @aj-marketing that timing works for most partners but hardware partner (EdgeCloud) asked for earlier announce to sync distributor channel — asked for Fri morning. We should surface that conflict.
lena-sis: If EdgeCloud needs Fri, list of partners requiring early notify? We might do staggered announcements but need to coordinate press messaging.
sienna-legal: Staggering is fine; legal just needs the exact language per cohort. If wording differs, send both drafts.
kevin-product: Landing can support staggered CTA flows. We’ll add a feature flag for EdgeCloud CTA that flips earlier. Minimal dev work.
deploy-bot: [automated] Checklist status: press draft: 20% | blog draft: 0% | landing prototype: 90% | SI kit: 80% | legal review queued. Use /launch-check to update.
aj-marketing: I'll prioritize a short press memo + FAQ for legal and the EdgeCloud variant. Working doc: https://short.url/marketplace-press-draft
kevin-product: @aj-marketing please include the required Marketplace product IDs and sample manifests so ENG can validate parsing.
oliver-eng: Noted. I’ll run the validation job once manifests are in. Send to infra-staging bucket.
maria-partnerships: Action items roundup: @aj-marketing press + blog (owner), @kevin-product landing + manifests (owner), @lena-sis SI kit + onboarding (owner), @sienna-legal legal review (owner), @devon-ops deploy plan (owner). I’ll coordinate partner-specific ask (EdgeCloud).
devon-ops: Can you confirm staging cutover window? Proposed Thu 23:00 PT for content freeze, Fri 00:30 PT deploy, then Wed 10:00 PT public embargo (unless EdgeCloud moves).
lena-sis: SI kit note — need sample API keys redacted and a short runbook snippet for partner SIs. Can someone add that to the runbook doc?
aj-marketing: Adding runbook snippet now. Will ping when done.
sienna-legal: Once press memo and partner quotes are in, I’ll route for signoff. If we hit blockers, escalate to legal@redwood.
maria-partnerships: EdgeCloud request: they want a private pre-brief with their press contacts on Tue. Does that break embargo?\sienna-legal: Private pre-briefs are okay under NDA. Need list of external contacts and the exact materials shared.\aj-marketing: We can do a pre-brief + embargoed deck for EdgeCloud under NDA. I'll coordinate.
kevin-product: Minor flag: the EdgeCloud listing requires a hardware SKU table on the landing page. Design will need specs.
oliver-eng: We can expose SKU table via a small JSON blob; front-end will render. Send schema.
deploy-bot: [automated] Next milestone: content freeze Thu 23:00 PT. Legal signoff deadline: Fri 12:00 PT. Confirm owners update checklist.
maria-partnerships: OK — everyone please add your final status to the doc and update the checklist. We'll do a dry-run standup Fri 09:00 PT to walk through the publish sequence.
aj-marketing: Copy + EdgeCloud slide pushed. Ping when legal has comments.
sienna-legal: Reviewing now, will update in-thread with redlines by EOD.
lena-sis: SI kit updated with redacted keys and onboarding checklist. Link: https://short.url/si-kit-v2
devon-ops: Confirmed staging window and rollback plan. I’ll schedule the ops bridge for deploy.
maria-partnerships: Thanks team — last ask: if anyone hits a blocker that delays legal or assets, flag here immediately. Otherwise we aim for the embargo Wed 10:00am PT (or EdgeCloud Fri variant). :rocket:
